definitions.explanation: Describes something that is not difficult to do or understand. The opposite of {難|むずか}しい (difficult).
Can also describe something that is simple and not elaborate.

{簡単|かんたん}な⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
{簡単|かんたん} is a na-adjective with two main meanings: 'easy' (not difficult) and 'simple/brief' (not elaborate).

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {簡単|かんたん}な + noun
- Adverb: {簡単|かんたん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (easily, simply, briefly)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {簡単|かんたん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: to put it simply
- {簡単|かんたん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to explain briefly
- ⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{簡単|かんたん}: easier than expected
- {簡単|かんたん}な⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: simple cooking / easy recipes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧: difficult (for sense 1)
- ⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧: complicated (for sense 2)

WATCH OUT:
In some contexts, {簡単|かんたん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ can imply 'carelessly' or 'too easily': {簡単|かんたん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧な (Don't give up so easily).
